subject: general
question: Which agency coordinates with various federal and state government agencies and departments to collect and compile the data required to calculate the GDP in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Statistical Office**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Statistical Office (NSO) is responsible for coordinating with various federal and state government agencies to collect and compile data required to calculate the GDP in India.
 
• The NSO operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
 
• The NSO is divided into two wings: the Central Statistical Office (CSO) and the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO).
 
• It plays a crucial role in providing statistical data on various economic indicators, including GDP, inflation, employment, and more.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP):**

 
 
• GDP is a monetary measure that represents the market value of all final goods and services produced in a country during a specified period.
 
• It is used as a broad measure of a nation's overall economic activity and health.
 
• GDP can be calculated using three approaches: the production approach, the income approach, and the expenditure approach.
 
 
 
• **Central Statistical Office (CSO):**
 
 
• CSO is responsible for coordinating statistical activities in the country and for evolving and maintaining statistical standards.
 
• It compiles and publishes the National Accounts Statistics (NAS), including GDP estimates.
 
 
 
• **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO):**
 
 
• NSSO conducts large-scale sample surveys across various socio-economic subjects to collect data on household consumption expenditure, employment-unemployment, and more.
 
• This data is crucial for planning and policy formulation by the government.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**
 
 
• MoSPI is the nodal ministry responsible for the development of the statistical system in India.
 
• It oversees the functioning of NSO and ensures the implementation of statistical policies and standards.
